## Requirements

- ci.yml matrix {ubuntu-latest, macos-latest}; toolchain pinned;
  node+python provisioned for the E2/E3 foreign legs; existing steps
  kept; spike stays non-gating; each leg runs the fast-path decision +
  uploads its own $RUNNER_OS-named anchor; `actions: read` kept;
  new steps follow the step-mode convention.
- deny.toml + cargo-deny job (pinned): licenses allow-list
  (MIT/Apache/ISC/MPL family), advisories, bans, sources = crates.io.
- gitleaks job over full history (--log-opts=--all) + PR diff, reusing
  the committed .gitleaks.toml (CC1; test-PKI allowlist already landed
  at R4.5c).
- .github/dependabot.yml: github-actions + cargo (security-only).
- live-verify.yml: workflow_dispatch only, environment: live-verify,
  secrets mapped to NAMEs, legs selected by input, evidence uploaded as
  artifact; hermetic lint asserts no pull_request trigger.
- Actions pinned by commit SHA; permissions contents: read default.
- rustdoc step: RUSTDOCFLAGS="-D warnings" cargo doc --workspace
  --no-deps (one leg); warnings fixed.
- R4.2a deliverable 5: scripts/ci/full-run.sh read <sha> [--repo o/n]
  + scripts/ci/test-full-run.sh (gh shim + fixtures); M9 (cancelled
  job never reads pass); the third AC-1 self-test.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] PR CI shows both matrix legs + cargo-deny + gitleaks green

- [ ] universal phase-gate AC

## Deviation — size budget

~1,116 changed lines (~1,099 authored, ~17 generated) vs the 600
envelope (≈1.9×) — **recorded deviation, operator decides**: the
ticket's own amendment (MINOR-6, added after sizing) makes the ~110-line
doc-comment sweep mandatory — the `cargo doc -D warnings` AC cannot
land green without fixing every surfaced warning — and the two
supply-chain jobs, the live-verify workflow pair, and the D-D reader
are all named deliverables. Under the standing 151a split the
production half alone is ≈ 568 ≤ 600; nothing here is padding.
Recorded verbatim per the L4.2 precedent ("Landed whole; the
operator's merge gate decides").
